name: user-sudo-nopasswd
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: grants an account unrestricted passwordless sudo through a sudoers drop-in. Vars: USERNAME (required); DROPIN_NAME (optional, default 00-nopasswd).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

: "${USERNAME:?USERNAME is required}"
dropin="${DROPIN_NAME:-00-nopasswd}"

install -d -m 0755 /etc/sudoers.d
printf '%s ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n' "$USERNAME" > "/etc/sudoers.d/${dropin}"
chmod 0440 "/etc/sudoers.d/${dropin}"
if command -v visudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    visudo -cf "/etc/sudoers.d/${dropin}" >/dev/null
fi
